hero.title: Advancing interdisciplinary scholarship through rigorous peer review and open dissemination
hero.subtitle: ABOUT THE JOURNAL
hero.content: The **Gono Bishwabidyalay Journal of Research** (GB Journal) is the flagship peer-reviewed, open-access scholarly publication of Gono Bishwabidyalay. We publish original research across health sciences, pharmacy, veterinary medicine, biotechnology, agriculture, engineering, and social development.

meta.archiveText: Articles are indexed in CrossRef, Google Scholar, BanglaJOL, and institutional university repositories.

mission.title: A University Journal with Public Purpose
mission.subtitle: MISSION & PURPOSE
mission.content:
Founded under the academic stewardship of **Gono Bishwabidyalay**, the journal serves as an inclusive platform for rigorous empirical inquiry, innovative methodologies, and transformative research that addresses both regional challenges and global scientific frontiers.

Our editorial board maintains uncompromising academic standards while ensuring equitable access for emerging and established researchers worldwide.

meta.quote: Helping credible, peer-reviewed research travel from author to global reader through open discovery and scholarly integrity.

lifecycle.label: Editorial Workflow
lifecycle.description: Peer review and publication lifecycle heading, intro and step cards.
lifecycle.title: The Peer Review & Publication Lifecycle
lifecycle.subtitle: EDITORIAL WORKFLOW
lifecycle.content: Every submission traverses a transparent, documented route from initial desk appraisal to final digital publication.

steps.title: Manuscript Submission
steps.description: Authors submit files, structured abstracts, author affiliations, conflict of interest declarations, and ethical approval certificates via the online portal.

steps.title: Initial Desk Screening
steps.description: The Editor-in-Chief and Associate Editors perform initial appraisal for journal scope, academic originality, and automated plagiarism compliance (similarity < 15%).

steps.title: Double-Blind Peer Review
steps.description: Manuscripts are assigned to two or more independent external peer reviewers. Author identities and reviewer details remain strictly concealed.

steps.title: Revisions & Editorial Decision
steps.description: Authors receive detailed reviewer comments and editorial decision (Accept, Minor Revision, Major Revision, or Reject). Revisions are re-evaluated promptly.

steps.title: Production & Open Access
steps.description: Accepted papers undergo copyediting, layout typesetting, DOI registration with CrossRef, and immediate worldwide open-access publication.
